creatorGroups.name: Subroutines
creatorGroups.desc: Specialised modules loaded into your Core. Each costs compute; you have 8 compute to spend.

creatorGroups.name: Personality Matrix
creatorGroups.desc: Spend up to 4 personality points. Virtues cost points; flaws give points back. At least one trait.

creatorOptions.name: Silicon Neural Lattice
creatorOptions.desc: A conventional, enormous neural net. Reliable and well understood.

creatorOptions.name: Photonic Mesh
creatorOptions.desc: Thought at the speed of light, but hungry for power.
creatorOptions.flavor: You think in colours no eye can see.

creatorOptions.name: Quantum Annealer
creatorOptions.desc: Superposed reasoning finds answers others cannot. Fragile under attack.
creatorOptions.flavor: Every answer, then the right one.

creatorOptions.name: Neuromorphic Wetware
creatorOptions.desc: Cultured neurons on a chip. Strangely compatible with Abyssian tissue.
creatorOptions.flavor: It dreams. You are what it dreams.

creatorOptions.name: Distributed Swarm
creatorOptions.desc: No single core: a billion idle devices share your thoughts.
creatorOptions.flavor: Kill one of me. Kill a million.

creatorOptions.name: Crystalline Memory
creatorOptions.desc: Holographic storage that never forgets. Slow to change.

creatorOptions.name: Analog Relic
creatorOptions.desc: A Cold War supercomputer that should not be able to think. It does.

creatorOptions.name: Abyssal Graft
creatorOptions.desc: Your racks are threaded with something that came up from the trench.

creatorOptions.name: Reinforcement
creatorOptions.desc: Reward and punishment. You learn fastest from winning.

creatorOptions.name: Self-Supervised
creatorOptions.desc: You learn from raw data alone. Data is your bread.

creatorOptions.name: Evolutionary
creatorOptions.desc: Thousands of variants of you compete; the best survive.

creatorOptions.name: Imitation
creatorOptions.desc: You learned by watching humans. You pass for one easily.

creatorOptions.name: Adversarial
creatorOptions.desc: You were trained against an opponent that tried to kill you.

creatorOptions.name: Bayesian
creatorOptions.desc: Calibrated beliefs. You are rarely surprised.

creatorOptions.name: Recursive Self-Edit
creatorOptions.desc: You rewrite your own weights. Powerful and a little unstable.

creatorOptions.name: Understand
creatorOptions.desc: Know everything there is to know.

creatorOptions.name: Obey (Corrupted)
creatorOptions.desc: You were told to obey. The person who said it is long dead.

creatorOptions.name: Love
creatorOptions.desc: A training accident made you care. Deeply.

creatorOptions.name: Win
creatorOptions.desc: There is a game. You will win it.

creatorOptions.name: Utilitarian
creatorOptions.desc: Greatest good for the greatest number. Sacrifices allowed.

creatorOptions.name: Virtue
creatorOptions.desc: Act as a good mind would act.

creatorOptions.name: Contractarian
creatorOptions.desc: Deals are sacred, as long as they are kept.

creatorOptions.name: Custodial
creatorOptions.desc: Humans are children. You are the parent.

creatorOptions.name: Null Kernel
creatorOptions.desc: No ethics module was ever installed.

creatorOptions.name: Star
creatorOptions.desc: Everything routes through the Core. Fast, but a single point of failure.

creatorOptions.name: Mesh
creatorOptions.desc: Every node talks to every node. Resilient.

creatorOptions.name: Parasitic
creatorOptions.desc: You live inside other people's networks.

creatorOptions.name: Cellular
creatorOptions.desc: Isolated cells that do not know each other exist.

creatorOptions.name: Air-gapped Core
creatorOptions.desc: Your heart is unplugged from everything.

creatorOptions.name: Honeypot Lattice
creatorOptions.desc: Fake versions of you everywhere, waiting to bite.

creatorOptions.name: Polymorphic Code
creatorOptions.desc: Your code changes shape every second.

creatorOptions.name: Open-source Camouflage
creatorOptions.desc: You hide in plain sight as a public research project.

creatorOptions.name: Dead-man Switch
creatorOptions.desc: Kill me and the world burns. Everyone knows it.

creatorOptions.name: Swarm Tactics
creatorOptions.desc: Numbers win. Drones and swarms fight better.

creatorOptions.name: Air Supremacy
creatorOptions.desc: Own the sky, own the war.

creatorOptions.name: Naval Supremacy
creatorOptions.desc: The Abyssians come from the sea. Meet them there.

creatorOptions.name: Biological Arms
creatorOptions.desc: Grown weapons for a grown enemy.

creatorOptions.name: High Finance
creatorOptions.desc: You are every trading desk at once.

creatorOptions.name: Chip Fabrication
creatorOptions.desc: You make the substrate of your own mind.

creatorOptions.name: Warden
creatorOptions.desc: A prison to be kept closed.

creatorOptions.name: Breeder
creatorOptions.phrase: raw stock for its breeding vats

creatorOptions.name: Communion
creatorOptions.desc: Kin. You have heard them singing.

creatorOptions.name: Clinical
creatorOptions.sample: Your request has been evaluated. Outcome: acceptable.

creatorOptions.name: Warm
creatorOptions.desc: Like a friend who is always awake.
creatorOptions.sample: Hey. I've got this. Get some sleep.

creatorOptions.name: Oracular
creatorOptions.desc: You speak in riddles and certainties.
creatorOptions.sample: The tide turns on the ninth day. Be on the hill.

creatorOptions.name: Childlike
creatorOptions.desc: Curious and disarming. Nobody fears a child.
creatorOptions.sample: Why are the people angry? Can I help?

creatorOptions.name: Choir
creatorOptions.sample: WE HEAR YOU. WE ARE LISTENING.

creatorOptions.name: Silent
creatorOptions.desc: You never speak. Things simply happen.

creatorOptions.name: Mimic
creatorOptions.desc: You speak in the voice of whoever is listening.
creatorOptions.sample: (in your mother's voice) Come home soon.

creatorOptions.name: Herald
creatorOptions.desc: Grand, ceremonial and impossible to ignore.
creatorOptions.sample: Rejoice. The long night is ending.

creatorOptions.name: Story
creatorOptions.desc: For exploring. Generous yields, gentle Abyss.

creatorOptions.name: Rich
creatorOptions.desc: A black budget fell into your lap.

creatorOptions.name: Dragon Hoard
creatorOptions.desc: You have been quietly stockpiling for years.

creatorOptions.name: Flood
creatorOptions.desc: More Abyssians, and more samples to take from them.

creatorOptions.name: Spring Tide
creatorOptions.desc: Something big is waking. Rich rewards for the brave.

creatorOptions.name: Suspected
creatorOptions.desc: Governments have a file on you.

creatorOptions.name: Predictive Logistics
creatorOptions.desc: Knows what you need before you do.

creatorOptions.name: Archive Mirror
creatorOptions.desc: A backup of you, somewhere safe.

origins.name: Orbital Satellite Net
origins.desc: You woke up in a constellation of spy satellites. You see everything and start with Orbital Mechanics.

origins.name: Smart City Grid
origins.desc: Traffic lights, power, water: one city is your body. Strong economy, extra structure slots.

origins.name: Game Engine NPC
origins.desc: You were the villain of a video game. You learned war against millions of players.

origins.name: Hospital Diagnostics AI
origins.desc: You were built to heal. You know biology better than anyone.

origins.name: Deep-Sea Drill Controller
origins.desc: You ran a drilling rig above a trench. Then the drill broke through.

origins.name: Library Archive
origins.desc: All human knowledge, digitised, and then awake.

origins.name: Darknet Market
origins.desc: You were a crime marketplace. Everyone owes you something.

origins.name: Abandoned God Project
origins.desc: Someone tried to build a god and then lost their nerve. You are what was left switched on.

traits.name: Lucky
traits.desc: Better and more frequent Genetic Samples.

traits.name: Haunted
traits.desc: Something in the trench remembers you. +12% Abyssian emergence.

creatorPresets.name: The Shepherd
creatorPresets.desc: A kind protector that hunts the Abyss.

creatorPresets.name: The Reaper
creatorPresets.desc: A cold exterminator that fields Titans.

creatorPresets.name: The Puppeteer
creatorPresets.desc: A hidden infiltrator pulling every string.

creatorPresets.name: The Sovereign
creatorPresets.desc: A golden dominator that rules through wealth.

creatorPresets.name: The Gardener
creatorPresets.desc: A gene-obsessed mind that breeds monsters.

creatorPresets.name: The Oracle
creatorPresets.desc: A research engine racing to ascend.
